Expertise in OEM Faucet Manufacturing and Customization # Byson stands as a trusted OEM faucet manufacturer based in Taiwan, delivering a broad selection of high-quality faucets for kitchens, bathrooms, and commercial spaces. Our specialization in OEM services allows us to address the unique needs of international brands, wholesalers, and project contractors. With decades of industry experience, our team supports clients through every stage—from initial design to the finished product—ensuring each faucet is stylish, durable, and cost-effective.
Why Partner with Byson for Faucet Manufacturing? # Byson is more than a faucet factory; we are your comprehensive custom faucet supplier, offering end-to-end production capabilities:
In-house mold development and component manufacturing Multiple surface finish options: chrome, matte black, brushed nickel, gold, and more Choices of ceramic cartridge, compression cartridge, washerless cartridges, aerators, and handle types Logo engraving, private label packaging, and customized accessories Compliance with NSF, CUPC, and other international standards Our ISO-certified facility is equipped with advanced production lines, ensuring consistent quality and timely delivery for clients worldwide.
Kitchen Faucet Lavatory Faucet Tub Shower Faucet Fountain Faucet Commercial Faucet Frequently Asked Questions # Q: What services do you offer as an OEM faucet manufacturer?
A: We provide comprehensive OEM services , including faucet design, tooling, manufacturing, surface treatment, logo customization, packaging, and global shipment.
Q: Can I customize the design or finish of the faucet?
A: Yes, we offer a variety of custom finishes such as chrome, matte black, brushed nickel, gold, and more. Handle styles, spout, and faucet body shapes can also be modified to your specifications.
Q: Do you manufacture both kitchen and bathroom faucets?
A: Absolutely. Our range includes kitchen faucets , fountain faucets , lavatory faucets , and other plumbing accessories for both residential and commercial use.
Q: What materials are used in your faucets?
A: Our faucets are primarily crafted from brass, stainless steel, or zinc alloy, selected according to your requirements and budget. All materials comply with international safety standards.
Q: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
A: We offer flexible MOQ options for OEM orders, supporting low-volume orders for new projects or market testing.
Q: Can I request samples before placing an order?
A: Yes, samples are available for evaluation. The sample cost may be refunded upon official order confirmation.
Q: Do you provide custom packaging for OEM brands?
A: Yes, we offer complete packaging customization, including logo printing, color boxes, blister packs, and instruction manuals tailored to your branding.
Q: How do you ensure the quality of your faucets?
A: Our in-house quality control covers every stage of production. Each batch undergoes leak testing, surface inspection, and durability tests. Additional procedures include salt spray tests, life-span testing, film thickness measurements, spectrometer analysis, destruction tests, and high-temperature oven testing to guarantee consistent, zero-defect products.
Q: Can you assist with faucet design and product development?
A: Yes, our experienced R&D team can help with faucet styling, structure optimization, and mold development based on your ideas or technical drawings.
Q: Are your faucets exported internationally?
A: Yes, our products are shipped worldwide, with key markets including the United States and Canada.
Q: What kind of support do you offer after order delivery?
A: We provide ongoing technical support, spare parts supply, and prompt responses to any quality-related issues, ensuring your satisfaction and long-term cooperation.
For further information or to discuss your project needs, please contact us .

Commercial-Grade Plumbing for Restaurants: Reliability and Performance # Restaurant plumbing systems are engineered to withstand higher water flow rates and more intensive usage than standard household setups. Durability and the ability to handle elevated water pressures are essential, as these systems must support the rigorous demands of busy restaurant environments.
At Byson, we recognize the critical role that dependable plumbing products play in restaurant operations. Our extensive range of plumbing products is tailored to meet the specific requirements of the food service industry, ensuring both reliability and compliance with hygiene standards.
Versatile Commercial Faucets and Drains # Our commercial faucets are constructed from high-quality, lead-free copper, offering superior corrosion resistance and longevity. Designed for efficiency and ease of use, these faucets are available in various configurations, including pre-rinse, wall-mounted, and deck-mounted models. Specialized options are also available for tasks such as dishwashing and handwashing, making them suitable for everything from small cafés to large restaurant chains.
To support optimal hygiene and regulatory compliance, our high-capacity plumbing drains are engineered to minimize the risk of clogging. This focus on drainage helps prevent operational downtime and potential revenue loss due to plumbing issues.
Restaurant plumbing systems and fixtures Commercial Faucets and Drains Quality Control for Restaurant Plumbing Products Commitment to Quality and Precision # High-quality plumbing products with precise tolerances are vital for restaurant applications. Byson employs comprehensive quality control measures, utilizing advanced equipment such as salt spray test machines, life test machines, film thickness testers, water outlet drip and life test machines, leak test machines, spectrometers, destruction test machines, and high-temperature boxes. This rigorous approach ensures consistent product performance and reliability.
Partnership Opportunities # If you are seeking to broaden your product range, we invite you to consider Byson as your partner. With our robust production capacity, diverse product offerings, and dedicated customer service, we are prepared to help you meet your business goals and the needs of your customers in the restaurant industry.

Elevating Public Restroom Standards with Automatic Soap Dispensers # Maintaining cleanliness and hygiene in shopping malls is essential, especially in high-traffic areas where visitors expect both functionality and aesthetics. Our range of automatic sanitizer dispensers is designed to seamlessly integrate into malls, stores, and other commercial environments, offering a blend of style and practicality.
Versatile and User-Friendly Design # The multi-function soap dispensers are engineered for flexibility, supporting foam, liquid, and spray formats. Constructed from a combination of plastic and stainless steel, these units are both durable and visually appealing. Their refillable design helps reduce waste and simplifies ongoing maintenance, making them a practical choice for facility managers.
A smart LED indicator is incorporated to provide real-time status updates, such as low battery alerts, ensuring that dispensers remain operational and reliable for guests.
Byson Touchless Soap Dispenser for Shopping Malls Creating a Clean and Elegant Environment # Our commercial touchless soap dispensers are designed to enhance the atmosphere of public restrooms, providing a hygienic, hands-free experience. Users can access soap and wash their hands without moving away from the sink, which helps contain both water and soap within the basin area. This design not only supports cleanliness but also streamlines restroom maintenance.
Byson Wall Mounted Automatic Soap Dispenser Byson Commercial Touchless Soap Dispenser Innovative Features for Easy Operation # The dispensers are designed for adaptability. By simply changing the soap pump, the unit can be converted to dispense foam, liquid, or spray, depending on the needs of the environment. The patented foam soap pump produces generous, soft, cloud-like bubbles and incorporates advanced technology to prevent leakage and residue build-up, ensuring a clean and efficient user experience.

As a global advocate for clean water and safe sanitation, we dedicate ourselves to improving access to clean water, promoting safe sanitation, and supporting health and conservation initiatives worldwide. Our approach is grounded in a philosophy of continuous improvement and the implementation of effective, relevant policies.

Customer Focus # Our commitment to customers is reflected in a robust supply chain, strengthened product design capabilities, and an expanded product line. We strive to deliver quality products on time, always aiming to meet and exceed customer value propositions.
Culture and Human Resources # We respect the potential and job satisfaction of every employee. By fostering a culture of innovation and encouraging fearless business development, we aim to create a corporate environment that maximizes the collective strength of our organization.
